mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVATT50060.retrieveSendEmailInfo */ mc.mail_id , cc.common_code_desc sender_name , cc.code_data2_value as sender , cc.code_data3_value as value3 , cc.code_data4_value as value4 , cc.code_data5_value as value5 , mc.subject_text as subject , mc.mail_detail_content as mail_content from lgcom_common_code_c cc , lgcom_mail_content_n mc WHERE cc.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_MAIL_TEMPLATE_LIST' AND cc.common_code = #{emailInfo} AND mc.mail_id = TO_NUMBER(cc.CODE_DATA1_VALUE)

SELECT /* LGVATT50060.retrieveManagerEmailList */ DISTINCT w.manager_no_1 AS manager_no ,e.full_name_local AS manager_name ,w.manager_email_1 AS manager_email FROM tb_att_emp_ul_warning w JOIN emp_master e ON w.manager_no_1 = e.employee_number WHERE w.manager_no_1 IS NOT NULL
